name: Spar topsides
description: Topside supported on a deep-draft single vertical cylinder (classic, truss or cell spar) with a typical fixed-platform-style deck carrying drilling and production equipment and dry-tree risers; low heave motion suits ultra-deepwater.

specifications.basis: installed by Thialf March 2009 with living quarter added three days later; heaviest single-lift topsides in GOM by HLCV at the time
deepest spar in world at time of source
support oil and gas processing, drilling rig and living quarters
